description: This file defines API endpoints for managing agents within the LiteLLM platform, including registering, retrieving, updating, deleting, and making agents public. It uses FastAPI to create RESTful endpoints and interacts with a database via Prisma client and in-memory registry. The code includes detailed documentation and example usage for each endpoint.

methods.name: get_agents( request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of agents accessible to the user, with filtering based on user roles and permissions.

methods.name: create_agent( request: AgentConfig, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new agent, validating against existing names, and registers it both in the database and in-memory registry.

methods.name: get_agent_by_id(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific agent by its ID from in-memory cache or database.

methods.name: update_agent( agent_id: str, request: AgentConfig, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates an existing agent's configuration in the database and refreshes its registry entry.

methods.name: patch_agent( agent_id: str, request: PatchAgentRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Partially updates an agent's configuration, similar to full update but with patch semantics.

methods.name: delete_agent(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes an agent from the database and deregisters it from memory.

methods.name: make_agent_public( agent_id: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Adds an agent to the public discoverable group, updating configuration accordingly.

methods.name: make_agents_public( request: MakeAgentsPublicRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Marks multiple agents as public, updating the global configuration.

methods.name: get_agent_daily_activity( agent_ids: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, exclude_agent_ids: Optional[str] = None, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Fetches daily activity statistics for specific agents or all accessible agents.
